title: Discover, Falsify, Revise: Auditing Input-Use Claims from Source Code to Predictive Contribution in Agent-Discovered Cell Models

three_questions.label: Source consumption
three_questions.question: Can the input enter the cited computation?
three_questions.test: Inspect the registered input-use claim and its cited source path.

three_questions.label: Fitted dependence
three_questions.question: Do fitted predictions change when the input changes?
three_questions.test: Replace one registered input at a frozen checkpoint; measure prediction distance.

three_questions.label: Predictive contribution
three_questions.question: Does the original input help predict the observed response?
three_questions.test: Compare target loss and predictive score under correct and replacement inputs.

scope.interpretation: Replacement effects are predictive evidence relative to registered replacements, not causal effects of biological interventions.

flagship.source_path_result: The cited compound-query attention has a single key-value pair and therefore a constant normalized weight.
flagship.selection_scope: Sources were selected within policy on Fold 3, then a prespecified across-policy rule used Fold 4. Fold 5 did not choose the source. Each Fold-5 source was independently refit using Folds 1–2 and checkpoint selection on Fold 3.

candidate_audit.sampling: Dataset–policy-balanced and source-structure-stratified sample of 48 real candidate sources; these counts describe this sampled set.
candidate_audit.interval: 95% source-group intervals condition on selected checkpoints, donor pools and 128 registered replacement maps; unadjusted descriptive intervals.

bbbc047_evidence_ladder.effect_definition: Compound/control PCC effects average over the other input’s two states in a 2×2 factorial audit. These differ from single-coordinate and Shapley effects.
bbbc047_evidence_ladder.reference_definition: Above/below/across counts compare effect quantile intervals with model-specific reference thresholds. They are distinct from positive mean effects or confidence intervals on means.

feedback.unit: five paired trajectories; F4 and F5 evaluate the same selected checkpoints and do not make n=10
feedback.protocol: Same serving model, anchor, search space permissions, optimization, training limit, PCC-first selection and five new candidate slots. Audit adds grouped errors, source checks and development-set compound/dose replacements.
feedback.interpretation: Audit has higher mean held-out PCC and compound/dose contributions on both folds. All paired-t 95% intervals for the 16 reported Audit–Score contrasts span zero. This is suggestive evidence across five trajectories, not a significant improvement claim.
feedback.bootstrap_note: Reported predictive percentile-bootstrap intervals exclude zero; conclusions depend on interval construction at five pairs. Use paired-t intervals in the primary interactive comparison and label them explicitly.

transfer.unit: Ten trajectory-selected endpoint instances; average five refits within each instance before interval calculation.
transfer.protocol: Fix selected source designs and audit rules before independent-acquisition transfer; refit fixed designs with no source revision or model reselection.
transfer.effect_definition: Compound and dose are two-player Shapley allocations relative to both inputs replaced. The both-shuffled residual completes Full−control-only; interaction is already allocated and must not be added again.
transfer.interpretation: Dose contribution and predictive gains persist. Compound identity does not pass the reference-relative criterion on LKCP, even though its Fold-5 mean Shapley allocation is positive. Positive mean contribution and per-refit qualification are distinct.

rendering_notes: The schema includes internal relative provenance strings; replace source links with actual repository paths before public linking.
Do not label Figure 2 candidate target-loss intervals as across-seed confidence intervals.
Do not turn the three evidence questions into a guaranteed nested success funnel: implemented, unresolved and fitted outcomes do not form an implication chain.
Do not pool the two linked BBBC cohorts as independent studies or two held-out sci-Plex folds as ten trajectories.
Retain per-panel statistical units and distinguish SD error bars from paired-effect confidence intervals.
The abstract-style claim of no compound support on LKCP is criterion-relative, not proof of zero biological compound effect.
